// A separable convolution: a horizontal pass then a vertical pass, equivalent
// to convolving with the outer product of the two tap arrays but far cheaper.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Separable_filter)
type SeparableKernel
    implements IValue
{
    HorizontalTaps: Array<Number>;
    VerticalTaps: Array<Number>;
}
